site.name: Home Ed Resource
site.title: Home Ed Resource | Good stuff for home ed, all in one place
site.description: A list of home education websites that a UK home ed family have actually used, with a note on who each one suited and when we last checked it. Free things first, paid things underneath.
site.shareDescription: We kept forgetting which home ed websites were any good, so we started writing them down. Free things first, paid things underneath.

tiers.label: Free
tiers.aside: genuinely free, not a trial that turns into a bill
tiers.empty: Nothing free on the list at the moment.

tiers.label: Paid
tiers.aside: nothing here yet, and that's on purpose
tiers.empty: We're trying a couple of paid things at the moment. We'd rather use them for a term before telling you to spend money on them, so this bit stays empty for now.

resources.title: iDEA
resources.description: Little online modules about computers, money and work skills. You earn badges as you go, and they add up to a Bronze, Silver or Gold award. Handy if you like having something to show for the term.

resources.title: Do Revision
resources.description: Revision questions and a plan for what to do next. The plan is the bit we found useful — without a school timetable, someone has to decide what gets revised today, and this does it for you.
